name: @veltravia/testing-core
description: Veltravia AI Testing & Debugging Agent core: detects a project's test surface, builds a structured TestPlan, runs validation/test commands ONLY through the existing Tool System + Secure Sandbox, classifies failures deterministically, diagnoses them with an explicit FACT/INFERENCE/RECOMMENDATION vocabulary, proposes bounded repairs that a human approves and the existing Coding Agent applies, and retests within a hard repair limit. Never a second execution pathway: no child processes, no host filesystem, no credentials, no permission or confirmation bypass.
